description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order to amend the amount of CESS on Sanitary towels, napkins etc., w.e.f. 26.09.2018
reasoning: This gazette content is a Legal/Regulatory matter as it contains an Order under Section 14 of the Sri Lanka Export Development Act, No. 40 of 1979, which rescinds the amount of CESS (a tax/levy) on specific articles. It involves regulatory changes to existing legislation rather than government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories.
